title: Knowledge Consistency Rules
description: Master consistency rules for Knowledge Records. Specification only — no runtime checker.

rules.statement: Each KR-* MUST have exactly one Canonical Definition block; competing definitions in the same record are forbidden.
Two distinct KR-* MUST NOT share the same Canonical Name for the same concept identity.
Canonical Name, aliases, and glossary preferred forms MUST NOT contradict each other without conflict notes.
Vietnamese / Chinese / Pinyin renderings SHOULD remain stable across records that cite the same concept.
Declared knowledge/node type MUST match the ontology registry (Concept, Entity, Rule, Pattern, Example, Source, Pack, Module).
Exactly one canonical Concept node per record_id (Unique Canonical Node).
Relationship types MUST be registered edge types; synonyms are forbidden in new declarations.
Duplicate (edge_type, source, target) triples are forbidden.
Cross-referenced KR-* / SRC-* / EX-* IDs MUST resolve in indexes, manifests, or bibliography SSOT (or be explicitly marked planned).
Hard Dependency and Inheritance edges MUST form a DAG; cycles are forbidden.
Reference-level links MUST NOT satisfy Hard Dependency publication gates.
Near-duplicate Canonical Definitions across two KR-* for the same concept MUST be merged or one deprecated.
Assertions marked confidence=high MUST NOT contradict each other within the same record without CONFLICTS_WITH / conflict notes.
Cross-record contradictions MUST be tracked via CONFLICTS_WITH or governance conflict registry.
Index canonical_key, alias, and record_index entries SHOULD agree on record_id for the same concept.
